text:
Maya Chen: quick heads-up — new-model shadow sweep (quant 4-bit) shows an odd drop vs fp16 on our curated faq holdout. starting this thread to collect fails and coordinate labeler checks.

Kevin Patel: ah ok which sweep id? link?

Maya Chen: sweep id: sweep/2024-07-12/qd4b-03 (https://ci.internal/sweeps/sweep/2024-07-12/qd4b-03)
summary: overall metric delta +3.1% EM drop compared to baseline-fp16, but only for prompts with long prefixed code blocks.

Sasha Li: can you paste a couple failing prompt examples? might be tokenization or truncation with quant kernel.

Maya Chen: sure — truncated examples below (redacted customer content):
```
Prompt A:
---
User: "How do I format a multi-line YAML with anchors for a helm chart?"
Context: <long_docs_truncated>
Expected: stepwise explanation + sample manifest
Model fp16 snippet: "Use &anchor ..." (full answer)
Model q4b snippet: "Use &anch" (cut mid-token)
```

Arjun Reddy: that looks like kv-cache / chunking difference at generation start. Are we using the same max_new_tokens and prefill lengths?

Maya Chen: yes config was identical: `--max_new_tokens 256 --prefill_chunk 1024` — but the q4b path uses an alternate tokenizer fallback in runtime that might apply subword adjustments.

labelops-bot: FYI — assigned golden review to @Sasha Li and @Kevin Patel for affected holdout subset (n=120).

Kevin Patel: I'll pull the top 50 failed prompts and create a micro-labeling batch. want labeler calibration to verify if outputs are semantically equivalent despite truncation artifacts.

Sasha Li: can we also run a quick synthetic repro locally? command i used earlier:
```
RUNTIME=local-quant4b ./run_inference.sh --model ./models/new-v1-q4b --input samples/fail-A.jsonl --out out/q4b-repro.jsonl
```

Maya Chen: thanks. I pushed a repro bundle to `gs://redwood-shadow/sweep-q4b-20240712/repro.tar.gz` with sample inputs + eval script.

Arjun Reddy: if it's truncation mid-token that's a tokenizer mismatch. possible causes: tokenizers library version drift, or we map to a legacy byte-level tokenizer for q4b path. can we diff tokenizer vocab hashes?

Maya Chen: good call. here's the hash from sweep run: `tokenizer_hash: 0x8b7a3f`
local fp16 run tokenizer_hash: `0x8b7a3f`
local q4b runtime tokenizer_hash: `0x7b9f21`

Kevin Patel: OK that's suspicious — runtime is picking different tokenizer binary. I'll file a quick infra ticket to lock the tokenizer bundle used for the sweep.

Sasha Li: label ops notes — for calibration we should: 1) randomize order to avoid anchoring, 2) include gold answers for 20% of items, 3) capture whether labeler marks output as "equivalent despite truncation" vs "broken".

Maya Chen: agreed. also want a small benchmark: run full holdout through model variants: fp16, q4b-kernel-A (current), q4b-kernel-B (experimental), and q4b-with-tokenizer-locked. we'll compare EM and a new "semantic match" label from labelers.

labelops-bot: label batch created: `lab-batch-8923` (n=120). owners: @Sasha Li, @Kevin Patel. ETA 48h.

Arjun Reddy: parallel ask for eng-runtime: can you record exact kernel selection trace per request (kernel_id + tokenizer_id) so we can correlate failures? small patch to add trace header `X-Kernel-Trace` should be fine.

ci-bot: Deploy queued: runtime/trace-header-v1 -> staging. link: https://ci.internal/deploys/5621

Kevin Patel: once labelers finish i'll aggregate labels and run the semantic-match scoring. if tokenizer mismatch is root cause we'll backfill q4b run with correct tokenizer and re-evaluate.

Sasha Li: for documentation — update prompt curation checklist: add item "verify tokenizer bundle parity across quantized runtime variants" and note the test command to compare hashes.

Maya Chen: thanks team. next steps: Kevin to run backfill if hash mismatch confirmed; Arjun to push trace header; Sasha to lead labeler calibration and report. will reconvene after label batch complete. :thumbsup:
